content: RFC 4180 describes a common CSV format including headers, records, quoting and embedded delimiters/newlines; RFC 8785 describes deterministic JSON canonicalization with sorted properties for repeatable hashing/signing. Use a compliant parser for inputs and canonical bytes for hashes, while preserving readable generated application JSON separately. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4180 and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785.
